title: Counting Items at the Counter
situation: A customer and clerk count items at a shop counter before the customer pays.
somali_situation: Macmiil iyo karraani ayaa alaab ku tirinaya miiska dukaanka ka hor inta macmiilku bixin lacagta.
key_phrases: How many notebooks are there?
There are five notebooks.
The number is five, not zero.
What is the total quantity?
The total is eight items.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How many notebooks are there?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: There are five notebooks.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The number is five, not zero.
dialogue.somali: Lambarku waa shan, eber ma aha.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, five notebooks.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I also have three pens.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Then the total is eight items.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the total quantity?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Eight items altogether.

title: Finding Your Place in Line
situation: A visitor asks a clerk about their position in line and which floor to go to next.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa karraani weydiinaya booskiisa safka iyo dabaqa uu xiga u tegayo.
key_phrases: Am I first or second in line?
You are third.
The first person is already inside.
The second person is at the desk.
Go to the second floor next.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
Visitor
dialogue.english: Am I first or second in line?
dialogue.somali: Ma anigaa koowaad mise labaad safka?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: You are third.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Who is first?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The first person is already inside.
dialogue.somali: Qofka koowaad gudaha ayuu hore ugu jiraa.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: And the second person?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The second person is at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: What is my position again?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Your position is third.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Where do I go after this?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Go to the second floor next.

title: Checking Prices at Checkout
somali_title: Qiimaha oo la hubinayo marka lacag la bixinayo
situation: A customer checks the price, decimal amount, cents, cost, and total at a checkout counter.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa hubinaya qiimaha, dhibicda jajabka, senti, kharashka, iyo wadarta marka lacagta la bixinayo.
key_phrases: What is the price of this rice?
The price is twelve dollars and fifty cents.
Yes, that decimal means fifty cents.
What is the total cost?
The total is fifteen dollars and twenty-five cents.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the price of this rice?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The price is twelve dollars and fifty cents.
dialogue.somali: Qiimuhu waa laba iyo toban doolar iyo konton senti.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The label says twelve point fifty.
dialogue.somali: Calaamaddu waxay leedahay laba iyo toban dhibic konton.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, that decimal means fifty cents.
dialogue.somali: Haa, dhibicdaasi waxay ka dhigan tahay konton senti.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Does the cost include tax?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: No, tax is added at checkout.
dialogue.somali: Maya, canshuurta waxaa lagu daraa marka lacagta la bixinayo.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the total cost?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The total is fifteen dollars and twenty-five cents.
dialogue.somali: Wadartu waa shan iyo toban doolar iyo shan iyo labaatan senti.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Could you put the price on the receipt?
dialogue.somali: Qiimaha ma ku qori kartaa rasiidka?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, the receipt shows each price.
dialogue.somali: Haa, rasiidku wuxuu muujinayaa qiime kasta.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good. I wanted to check the numbers.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waxaan rabay inaan tirooyinka hubiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Of course. Please check the receipt before you leave.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Fadlan rasiidka hubi ka hor intaadan bixin.

title: Reading Back a Telephone Number
somali_title: Lambar telefoon oo dib loo akhrinayo
situation: A patient gives a telephone number to a clinic clerk, who reads it back carefully with the country code, zero, double digits, and each digit.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa karraaniga rugta siinaya lambar telefoon, karraaniguna si taxaddar leh ayuu dib ugu akhriyaa koodhka dalka, eber, laba jeer, iyo tiro kasta.
key_phrases: Can I give you my telephone number?
Please start with the country code.
The country code is plus one.
The next digit is zero.
Could you read back the number?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Can I give you my telephone number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarkayga telefoonka ma ku siin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, please start with the country code.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan ku bilow koodhka dalka.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: The country code is plus one.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Good. Say each digit slowly.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Tiro kasta si tartiib ah u sheeg.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Six, one, two, five, five, five.
dialogue.somali: Lix, kow, laba, shan, shan, shan.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: That is double five, then another five?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa shan laba jeer, kadib shan kale?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, double five, then five.
dialogue.somali: Haa, shan laba jeer, kadib shan.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: What comes after that?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: The next digit is zero.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Then one, nine, eight?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, that is right.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Could you read back the number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarka dib ma u akhrin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Plus one, six one two, five five five, zero one nine eight.
dialogue.somali: Plus one, lix kow laba, shan shan shan, eber kow sagaal siddeed.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: Perfect. I saved it for the clinic.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Waxaan u kaydiyey rugta.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you for checking every digit.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad tiro kasta hubisay.

dialogue.speaker: Clinic Clerk
dialogue.english: You're welcome. Telephone numbers must be exact.
dialogue.somali: Waad mudan tahay. Lambarada telefoonku waa inay sax ahaadaan.

title: Confirming an Appointment Date
situation: A customer confirms an appointment date and checks the expiry date on a card.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa xaqiijinaya taariikh ballan, wuxuuna hubinayaa taariikhda uu kaarku dhacayo.
key_phrases: What date is my appointment?
The appointment is on Monday.
What day of the month?
It is the tenth of June.
The expiry date is in July.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What date is my appointment?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The appointment is on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What day of the month?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: It is the tenth of June.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: My clinic card has an expiry date.
dialogue.somali: Kaarkayga rugtu wuxuu leeyahay taariikh uu dhacayo.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The expiry date is in July.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: So the month is July?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, July.

title: Giving Years on a Form
situation: A student gives the year they were born and the year they started a course.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa bixinaya sannadkii uu dhashay iyo sannadkii uu koorso bilaabay.
key_phrases: What year were you born?
I was born in 1998.
What year did you start the course?
I started in 2024.
The range is from 2024 to 2026.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: What year were you born?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I was born in 1998.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: What year did you start the course?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I started in 2024.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Have you studied here since 2024?
dialogue.somali: Ma halkan ayaad wax ka baranaysay tan iyo 2024?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, since September 2024.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The range is from 2024 to 2026.
dialogue.somali: Xaddiga sannaduhu waa laga bilaabo 2024 ilaa 2026.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That is two years.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Correct. I will write those years.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you for checking the dates.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad taariikhaha hubisay.

title: Sharing a Cake in Fractions
situation: A customer asks a baker to cut a whole cake into fractions for guests.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa dubaha ka codsanaya inuu keeg dhan jajabyo ugu qaybiyo martida.
key_phrases: Can you cut the whole cake?
Cut half for the children.
A quarter is for my mother.
Can one third stay in the box?
That fraction is too large if we already cut half and a quarter.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you cut the whole cake?
dialogue.somali: Keegga oo dhan ma jari kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: Yes. How many pieces do you need?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Immisa xabbo ayaad u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Cut half for the children.

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: All right. Half of the cake for the children.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: A quarter is for my mother.

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: A quarter is smaller than half.
dialogue.somali: Rubuc wuu ka yar yahay nus.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can one third stay in the box?
dialogue.somali: Saddex-meelood meel ma ku hari kartaa sanduuqa?

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: That fraction is too large if we already cut half and a quarter.
dialogue.somali: Jajabkaasi aad buu u weyn yahay haddii aan hore u jarno nus iyo rubuc.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then leave the rest in the box.
dialogue.somali: Markaa inta hartay sanduuqa ku reeb.

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: Good. The rest is one quarter.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Inta hartay waa rubuc.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: So the whole cake is divided.
dialogue.somali: Markaa keegga oo dhan waa la qaybiyey.

dialogue.speaker: Baker
dialogue.english: Yes, half, a quarter, and a quarter.

title: Checking a Discount Percentage
somali_title: Boqolley qiimo-dhimis ah oo la hubinayo
situation: A customer asks a clerk how a discount percentage changes after a sale rate increases and then decreases at checkout.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa karraani weydiinaya sida boqolleyda qiimo-dhimistu isu beddesho marka heerka qiimo-dhimistu kordho kadibna hoos u dhaco marka lacagta la bixinayo.
key_phrases: What percent is the discount?
The discount is twenty percent.
Did the rate increase today?
It increased from fifteen percent to twenty percent.
The final price decreased by ten dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What percent is the discount?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The discount is twenty percent.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Did the rate increase today?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, it increased from fifteen percent to twenty percent.
dialogue.somali: Haa, wuxuu ka kordhay boqolkiiba shan iyo toban ilaa boqolkiiba labaatan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: So the sale is better than yesterday?
dialogue.somali: Markaa iibka qiimo-dhimista maanta wuu ka fiican yahay kii shalay?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, the rate is higher today.
dialogue.somali: Haa, heerku maanta wuu ka sarreeyaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Why did my total decrease by only ten dollars?
dialogue.somali: Maxay wadartaydu ugu yaraatay toban doolar oo keliya?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Because one item is not part of the discount.
dialogue.somali: Sababtoo ah hal shay kuma jiro qiimo-dhimista.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The final price decreased by ten dollars.
dialogue.somali: Qiimihii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu hoos ugu dhacay toban doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: That's right.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you show me the percent on the receipt?
dialogue.somali: Boqolleyda ma iga tusi kartaa rasiidka?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Here it is: twenty percent discount.
dialogue.somali: Waa tan: qiimo-dhimis boqolkiiba labaatan ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good. I wanted to compare the numbers.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waxaan rabay inaan tirooyinka is barbar dhigo.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The receipt shows the original price and the discount.
dialogue.somali: Rasiidku wuxuu muujinayaa qiimihii hore iyo qiimo-dhimista.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Now I understand the percentage.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Great. Your total is correct.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Wadartaadu waa sax.

title: Finding a Room Number
situation: A visitor asks a clerk for a room number, floor, wing, suite, and ward.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa karraani weydiinaya lambarka qol, dabaq, garab dhisme, suite, iyo waadh.
key_phrases: What is the room number?
The room number is 214.
It is on the second floor.
Go to the east wing.
The ward is next to Suite B.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: What is the room number?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: The room number is 214.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which floor is it on?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: It is on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Which wing should I use?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Go to the east wing.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is the ward near Suite B?
dialogue.somali: Waadhku ma ku dhow yahay Suite B?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.english: Yes, the ward is next to Suite B.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waadhku wuxuu ku xigaa Suite B.
